request.summary: Research a pre-action agent reasoning-engine contract using CAV2 constitutions and definitions, Dispatch Technique Catalog methods, anti-bias constraints, subagents, and risk-sensitive effort.
request.intent: Determine the smallest defensible semantic engine slice and its proof, authority, effort, replay, and effect boundaries before any implementation action.

execution.notes: Accepted result: the repository is not currently a reasoning engine. The smallest defensible first slice is semantic-judgment evaluator@1, an unwitnessed finite evaluator candidate separated from the replayable actor protocol and from CAV2-D37 entry/effect gates. AntiBiasVector is excluded until governed and witnessed.
